scope: The 6 admitted X509_VERIFY_POLICY production obligation(s) in src/x509/v3_ac_tgt.rs that the enumerated SSH closure reports as reachable but without an owning boundary receipt are enumerated here for ownership only, at their census coordinates, with a hazard read from each function. This receipt claims no discharge, no contract and no new reachability finding.
non_claims: This receipt does not discharge any site, and no site may be treated as discharged on its authority.
This receipt does not contract any site; the hazard notes are enumeration notes, not established contracts.
This receipt does not assert reachability; reachability is taken from the enumerated closure and is not re-established here.

boundaries.hazard: Raw OSSL_ISSUER_SERIAL is dereferenced; issuer and issuerUID pointers are forwarded to print helpers and serial is passed by address, all under the caller's liveness contract.
Raw OSSL_OBJECT_DIGEST_INFO is cast and dereferenced only after a null check; its enumerated and object values are read through ASN.1 helpers, and malformed input aborts the print.
Raw OSSL_TARGET_CERT is dereferenced and its targetCertificate, targetName and certDigestInfo members are forwarded to other raw printers when non-NULL.
Raw OSSL_TARGET is dereferenced and the selector type_ chooses a union member passed to a raw printer; an unknown selector prints nothing and still returns 1.
Raw STACK_OF(OSSL_TARGET) is iterated and each element forwarded to i2r_TARGET; stack liveness and element type are caller obligations.
Raw STACK_OF(OSSL_TARGETS) is iterated and each element forwarded to i2r_TARGETS; stack liveness and element type are caller obligations.
